top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature and empirically transformative programme that made trade exposure, changing task demand, local adjustment, and distributional consequences central to labour economics. Autor, Dorn, and Hanson are a defensible core when the citation is confined to those linked labour-market effects rather than treated as an account of all inequality or technological change.
recusal_note: None apparent from profile; disclosed labour-economics coauthor and institutional ties do not concern the P001 laureates.
